tours.name: Fixed Assets: Scrap and Sell an Asset

tours.description: Walks through selling a fixed asset to a customer: create and confirm a Sales Order, generate and post the Customer Invoice, then use the asset's Modify Asset > Sell action to post the disposal entry and close the asset.

description_i18n.en_US: Walks through selling a fixed asset to a customer: create and confirm a Sales Order, generate and post the Customer Invoice, then use the asset's Modify Asset > Sell action to post the disposal entry and close the asset.

steps.title: Create a new Quotation
steps.content: Click New to start a fresh Sales Order for selling the fixed asset.
